records.title: 10-Q 9.30.2024
records.text: Passenger revenue was $12.5 billion and remained relatively flat as compared to the third quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q 9.30.2024
records.text: Load factor was 86.6% for the third quarter of 2024, compared to 84.0% for the third quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q 9.30.2024
records.text: In the third quarter of 2024, we experienced a 5.2% decrease in passenger yield on a 3.2% capacity growth year-over-year, as measured by available seat miles (ASMs).

records.title: 10-Q 9.30.2024
records.text: This was primarily due to a 14.0% decrease in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel including related taxes to $2.50 in the third quarter of 2024 from $2.91 in the third quarter of 2023, offset in part by a 4.1% increase in gallons of fuel consumed due to increased capacity.

records.title: 10-Q 9.30.2024
records.text: In the third quarter of 2024, other nonoperating income, net primarily included $27 million of non-service related pension and other postretirement benefit plan income and $27 million of net special credits for mark-to-market net unrealized gains associated with certain equity investments, offset in part by $21 million of foreign currency losses.
